prompt_notes: Shield effect only: no emitter, generator, pedestal, statue, device, character, hand, weapon, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, numbers, logo, watermark, frame, or duplicate shield
Show exactly one complete intact spherical protective barrier centered on canvas and large enough to surround a game character
The shield surface must be a geodesic honeycomb mesh: many clearly recognizable connected six-sided hexagonal cells distributed across the whole circular field, like transparent energy glass
Use several depth bands of the same connected honeycomb mesh: brightest and densest at the outside rim, then progressively dimmer and more transparent toward the center
Do not substitute plain concentric circles, radial spokes, a single hexagon ring, scales, square tiles, dots, or a solid filled orb for the honeycomb mesh
Build a thick luminous outer edge from several crisp nested cyan and pale-blue pixel bands with a strong readable halo
Keep the center, every hexagonal cell interior, every lattice gap, and every pixel outside the shield empty; do not fill the orb with dark blue, gray, fog, glass color, or any opaque surface
Every empty pixel must be exactly solid #ff00ff chroma key; only cyan, pale-blue, and restrained violet energy lines may use non-chroma colors
Use dense crisp pixel detail without antialiasing, blur, smoke, soft opaque haze, or hot-pink pixels inside the artwork

notes: The human-provided shield image is functional inspiration only. Generate original artwork with no copied text, watermark, exact lattice, or arrangement.
This proof must retain a truly transparent interior and does not enter the package until its complete lifecycle passes human review.
